name: L&M
source:
This is an adventure game about the rape La**s and Me*r, main characters in Gu*dam SE*D DESTINY.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.melonbooks.com/index.php?main_page=product_info&products_id=IT0000100632]Melonbooks DL[/url].]
translation:
这是一款以侵犯拉克丝和米娅为题材的冒险游戏，她们是《机动战士高达SEED DESTINY》中的主要角色。

[大致翻译自[url=http://www.melonbooks.com/index.php?main_page=product_info&products_id=IT0000100632]Melonbooks DL[/url]。]
